question_text: Composition Conversion-From Weight Percent to Atom Percent. Determine the composition, in atom percent, of an alloy that consists of 97 wt% aluminum and 3 wt% copper. Give your answer as a tuple (aluminum atom percent, copper atom percent)The units of each required answer are (at%, at%), respectively.
response:
Using a 100 g basis with atomic weights Al = 26.98 g/mol and Cu = 63.55 g/mol:

- Moles Al = 97 / 26.98 = 3.595
- Moles Cu = 3 / 63.55 = 0.0472
- Total moles = 3.642

$$C_{\text{Al}} = \frac{3.595}{3.642}\times 100 \approx 98.70\text{ at\%}$$

$$C_{\text{Cu}} = \frac{0.0472}{3.642}\times 100 \approx 1.30\text{ at\%}$$

$$\boxed{(98.70,\ 1.30)}$$
